HowItWorksPage.title: How it works
HowItWorksPage.intro: Booking with Euronest is simple and personal: you choose the apartment, send us your request and we confirm it. Nothing is paid on the website.
HowItWorksPage.s1Text: Enter the city, dates and number of guests in the search. You will only see apartments available on those dates, with photos, layout, amenities and an indicative price.
HowItWorksPage.s2Text: Fill in the form with your details. When you send it you will see your booking reference and PIN, and you will receive an email with your request. Sending it is free and has no commitment.
HowItWorksPage.s3Text: We check availability and get in touch by email or WhatsApp to confirm the total and how to pay. Once the booking is confirmed, we send you the voucher as a PDF.
HowItWorksPage.s4Text: Show the voucher and your ID on arrival. The voucher QR code lets anyone check at any time that the booking is valid. During your stay, we are just a message away.
HowItWorksPage.ctaText: Search by city and dates, or tell us what you need and we will suggest options.

LongStaysPage.title: Long stays
LongStaysPage.intro: Coming to work, study or live for a while? We have furnished apartments for stays of one or several months, with special terms.
LongStaysPage.s1Text: Equipped kitchen, washing machine, bed linen, Wi-Fi and, in many apartments, a place to work. Just bring your suitcase.
LongStaysPage.s2Text: From 28 nights we offer special terms. Apartments marked “Long stay” are designed for this: tell us your dates and we will send you a proposal.
LongStaysPage.s3Text: From the start we tell you what the price includes (utilities, internet, cleaning) and how monthly payments work.
LongStaysPage.s4Text: A friendly team for maintenance, issues or any question while you live in the apartment, by WhatsApp or phone.
LongStaysPage.ctaText: Send us your dates and what you need, and we will suggest the apartments that fit best.

OwnersPage.title: Owners
OwnersPage.intro: Do you own an apartment and want to sell or rent it? We buy and rent homes in good areas of the cities where we work.
OwnersPage.s1Text: If you want to sell, we assess your home and make you an offer. A direct deal, with no intermediaries.
OwnersPage.s2Text: If you would rather not sell, we can agree a rental arrangement suited to your property and your timing.
OwnersPage.s3Text: We take care of maintenance, cleaning and guest support, so your apartment is always in good condition.
OwnersPage.s4Text: You deal with us directly and get the terms in writing before you decide.
OwnersPage.ctaText: Message us on WhatsApp or by email and we will reply as soon as possible.
OwnersPage.whatsAppMessage: Hello, I own an apartment and would like to talk to Euronest Apartamentos.
